test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

One of their freighters, / a Neptune, / will be leaving/ in two weeks.
solution:
The erroneous part is: '**a Neptune'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the given sentence is the use of the article **'a'** before **'Neptune'.**
 
• The definite article **'the'** should be used because we are referring to a specific freighter named **'the Neptune'**.
 
 
• **Corrected Sentence:** *“One of their freighters, **the Neptune**, will be leaving in two weeks.”*
 
 
 
• The indefinite article **'a'** is not appropriate in this context.
 
• Hence, **'a Neptune'** is the erroneous part.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article **'the'** is used before a noun when it refers to something **specific** or **previously mentioned.**

 
 
• Example: "I'm reading **the** book I bought yesterday."
 
• Example: "I saw a dog. **The** dog had a friendly face."
